description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. Regarding the Flood and Fossils. Why is it that there have not been any signs of humans like there have been of animals?

2. Why was a  bull sacrificed on the atonement day and not a lamb (Lev 16) 

3. Is consuming gelatin, in the form of jello, marshmallow, or supplements like vitamin D an issue with the Bible prohibition of consuming swine since gelatin used on these products sometimes comes from pork.
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
